title: fried eggs
body: First, crack your eggs into a bowl. Then heat olive oil in small sauce pan to 300F. Poar wisked eggs into hot oil and leave to cook for 4 minutes. Flip and leave for 5 minutes. Plate and serve.

title: boiled eggs
body: First, place eggs in pot. Then, add water. Heat on high until at a roaring boil. Keep at a boil for 25 to 30 minutes. Plate and serve shell on.

title: sliced watermelon
body: Get a chef knife and cut your (optionally chilled) watermelon into slices. Plate and serve fresh.
